title: Coverage & Gap Certification

selection_basis.strict_order: OARC-01 → OARC-02 → OARC-03 → OARC-04 → OARC-05 → OARC-06 → OARC-07
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: GPR-09 remains independently selected_not_started; MRCS-21 is terminal completed_verified.

objective: Audit the full governed operational-asset source surface and classify every relevant source record as game-ready, normalization needed, waiting on an existing owner, waiting on MERA, waiting on MBES, or source-insufficient; produce the durable coverage ledger and final OARC golden certification without improving coverage through fabricated semantics.
acceptance: Account for the full governed operational-asset source surface pinned by OARC-03, with source catalog counts/hashes reconciled to the coverage ledger.

Classify each relevant source record into exactly one final coverage disposition: game-ready, normalization needed, waiting on an existing owner, waiting on MERA, waiting on MBES, or source-insufficient.
Carry OARC-06 golden outcomes into coverage truth, including the explicit Hollowstep/Orrukhal missing exact MIB-14 owner-binding blocker.

Coverage percentages/counts must be derived from classified records only and may never be improved by source inference, guessed compatibility, guessed capacity, synthetic owner bindings or synthetic canonical content.
Publish a durable gap ledger that names the existing owner/future owner or source insufficiency responsible for every non-game-ready class.
Produce final OARC certification that distinguishes what is game-ready now from what remains blocked; do not claim MERA/MBES implementation.
Reconcile OARC program completion only if the final ledger/certification satisfies the program completion condition without duplicate authority or hidden future-family implementation.
boundaries: OARC-07 is coverage/gap certification only; it does not create new operational definitions merely to improve coverage.
Synthetic workflow scaffolding from OARC-06 cannot count as canonical game-ready content.
Source-only mecha/ship rows without exact owner bindings cannot be counted as game-ready through analogy or name matching.
Waiting on MERA and waiting on MBES are explicit future-owner classes, not implementation authority.
No new Asset, containment, Project, repair, combat, World, economy or construction runtime.
GPR remains independent and MRCS remains terminal completed history.
next_action: On an OARC-specific owner Continue, fresh-read OARC-07 plus OARC01 through OARC06 contracts, the pinned OARC-03 source registries/counts/hashes, actual source-record registries needed for row classification, and existing owner-binding catalogs; then execute the complete final coverage/gap certification tranche.
